title: The Capybara mod of all time
description: This is a capybara themed mod where you're goal is to kill the god of all capybaras using a god slayer sword.
body:
In my mod you must kill god, But how will you kill god you may ask?
by slaying Theo the Unchallenged you can get an igniter that leads to the capybara dimension 
then in the capybara dimension you must Kill the King Capybara which has a chance to drop shards.
these shards can be used to craft a godkiller blade and once you obtain that you must craft a God Summoner and then challenge god 

Btw the Capybara dimension portal is built using Brown Wool blocks and uses a special igniter

This mod requires Neoforge and is for 1.21.8 
it is heavily recommended you use JEI
